name: Strata 55
notes: Bedded sediment, weathered plank: anisotropy that CHANGES WITH SCALE - a coarse band squeezed 9:1 into flat beds, under isotropic fine grain at a fifth the weight. A first version weighted the grain at 0.45 and buried the bedding; this is the reworked one. TONAL dual-gate: the mask is the tone-mapped field itself, so the stroke carries the texture as graded alpha and the level number is the damage/modulation DEPTH. Rides the DEEP scattered train (dual scatter 0.7, spacing 0.07, n=12): a stationary Gaussian field averages to the same field, so it can spend the overlap that buys full scatter (docs/spectral-atlas.md §4). tonal.gain 3 restores the log-contrast that averaging costs; tonal.floor 0.02 stops one stamp's field minimum punching a full-ink speck through the stack. Tip from tips/strata.spec.json; audited by tools/spectrum-audit.mjs.
